column1: # The repository's labels: tool/board.sh labels writes them to GitHub, tool/board.sh check reads them.

column4: description

column1: # Type: exactly one per issue and pull request, the same word as the commit prefix.

column4: fix: something does not work as it should
feat: a new command, screen or behavior
docs: README, guides, audits, ADRs and other records
test: e2e scripts, anina tapes and fixtures, with no change to the product
refactor: same behavior, a better shape
chore: the quality gate, repository hygiene and the board

column1: # Area: every part the change touches, by path.

column4: rust/cli, the mandrake binary and its commands
rust/tui, the setup wizard and the watch, hex, bench and compare screens
rust/proxy, the local proxy that trims and measures
rust/meter, the event log and token counts
rust/layout and rust/home: links, backups, journal, rollback
data/plugins: prompt-trim, fancy, tui-embed
cfgs/shell and install.sh: the launcher, env.sh and the PATH block
